en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Abu Khadeeja who said, 
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said to me:

‘Beware of taking each other for judgement to the tyrannous people. But, look around for a man among you who knows something from our<sup>asws</sup> judgements, so make him to be between you (as a judge), for I<sup>asws</sup> have made him<sup>asws</sup> as a judge, so go to him for a judgement’.
en.sarwar: 4. Al-Husayn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla’ ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Ali from abu Khadijah who has narrated the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, once said to me,

‘Beware no one among you must take one another before the people of injustice. You must find among yourselves one who knows certain things of our judgment; then you must appoint him to judge for you; I have made him to judge for you and you must seek adjudication before him.’”
